_note: The proposed customer-facing structure of each collection's dataset: what one row is, and the columns to keep with a plain-English label and meaning. Written 2026-09-05 from the twelve flagship samples; meanings are read from the column names and ten rows of values and are to be confirmed by the terminal against the build scripts. Columns not listed here are pipeline bookkeeping and stay in the workspace (docs/COLUMN_ORDER_NOTE_FOR_THE_TERMINAL_2026-09-05.md has the drop lists). The viewer reads this file: labels become headings, meanings become the record's definitions, and unlisted columns fold under Technical fields.

funding/federal_funding_transactions.row: One federal assistance transaction (a grant, loan, direct payment or insurance action) reported on USAspending, linked to the Native entity that received it.
funding/federal_funding_transactions.where: workspace dist/review/spreadsheets/funding/federal_funding_transactions.csv; built by code/1135_full_dataset_review_bundle.py from the USAspending assistance archive.

fields.label: Cedar ID
fields.meaning: Cedar's permanent identifier for the Native entity this record is linked to. Join key across every collection.

fields.label: Native entity
fields.meaning: The entity's name as Cedar's register spells it, so one entity reads the same in every collection.

fields.label: Entity type
fields.meaning: Which of Cedar's eighteen classes the entity is (federally recognized tribe, Alaska Native village corporation, Native nonprofit, and so on).

fields.label: Transaction ID
fields.meaning: USAspending's unique key for this transaction. Cite it to find the exact record.

fields.label: Action date
fields.meaning: The date the agency took this action.

fields.label: Fiscal year
fields.meaning: The federal fiscal year of the action (October to September), which is what USAspending reports and what the year filter uses.

fields.label: Amount obligated
fields.meaning: Dollars obligated by this transaction. Negative values are de-obligations, kept as recorded.

fields.label: Amount in 2025 dollars
fields.meaning: The same amount adjusted for inflation to 2025 dollars.

fields.label: Assistance type
fields.meaning: What kind of assistance it is: formula grant, project grant, direct payment, loan, insurance.

fields.label: Program number
fields.meaning: The Assistance Listing (CFDA) number of the federal program.

fields.label: Program
fields.meaning: The federal program's name.

fields.label: Agency
fields.meaning: The department that made the award.

fields.label: Office
fields.meaning: The office within the department.

fields.label: Recipient as recorded
fields.meaning: The recipient's name as the award records it, before Cedar resolved it to the entity.

fields.label: Recipient UEI
fields.meaning: The recipient's federal Unique Entity ID.

fields.label: Recipient city
fields.meaning: City of the recipient's address on the award.

fields.label: Recipient state
fields.meaning: State of the recipient's address on the award.

fields.label: Recipient type as recorded
fields.meaning: How USAspending classifies the recipient (for example, federally recognized tribal government).

fields.label: Loan face value
fields.meaning: For loans, the face value of this loan; zero for grants.

fields.label: Award loan face value
fields.meaning: For loans, the face value of the whole award to date.

fields.label: Award number
fields.meaning: The award's Federal Award Identification Number; several transactions can share one.

fields.label: Award ID
fields.meaning: USAspending's key for the whole award; the source link is built from it.

fields.label: How the entity was matched
fields.meaning: How Cedar linked this recipient to the entity (for example, an exact UEI match).

fields.label: Match confidence
fields.meaning: Cedar's confidence in the link: A is strongest.

fields.label: Source
fields.meaning: The award's page on USAspending.

fields.meaning: The entity's name as Cedar's register spells it, so one entity reads the same in every collection.

fields.label: Entity type
fields.meaning: Which of Cedar's eighteen classes the entity is (federally recognized tribe, Alaska Native village corporation, Native nonprofit, and so on).

fields.label: EIN
fields.meaning: The organization's Employer Identification Number.

fields.label: Organization
fields.meaning: The organization's name as the IRS records it.

fields.label: Relationship to the entity
fields.meaning: Whether the organization is tribally controlled, tribally affiliated, or unruled.

fields.label: Organization type
fields.meaning: Whether the organization is itself a tribe, an ANC, a Native organization.

fields.label: State
fields.meaning: The organization's state.

fields.label: City
fields.meaning: Its city.

fields.label: NTEE code
fields.meaning: The IRS activity code for what the organization does.

fields.label: Filing tier
fields.meaning: Which IRS return it files: full 990, 990-EZ or 990-N.

fields.label: Tax subsection
fields.meaning: The 501(c) subsection (3 for charities).

fields.label: IRS ruling date
fields.meaning: When the IRS recognized the organization (year and month).

fields.label: Latest tax period
fields.meaning: The most recent tax period in the file.

fields.label: Revenue
fields.meaning: Revenue in the latest return the IRS holds.

fields.label: Assets
fields.meaning: Assets in that return.

fields.label: Income
fields.meaning: Income in that return.

fields.label: IRS file date
fields.meaning: The date of the IRS file these figures come from.

fields.label: Match confidence
fields.meaning: Cedar's confidence in the link to the entity: A is strongest.

fields.label: Source
fields.meaning: The IRS Business Master File.
